boost.rule: smallest weights within MIN_GAIN of the best mean over the three modes

fusion.mode_rule: keyword (needs no embedding model) unless another mode is better by MIN_GAIN
fusion.rule: weights closest to 1:1 within MIN_GAIN of the best

model.rule: bge-m3 only if better than nomic-embed-text by MIN_GAIN

rerank.rule: on only if the best reranked system beats the best unreranked one by MIN_GAIN

text.rule: decided with the chosen embedding model: the default compact text unless another length / rule set, or chunks, is better by MIN_GAIN
